description:
We were born from a shared curiosity: to discover how far science, technology, and imagination can go. We are a Paraguayan duo of two people who share a passion for space exploration, innovation, and developing new ideas.

We have skills in programming, video game development, 3D design, creativity, and teamwork. Through our project NOVA EON, we aim to bring space exploration closer to new generations through interactive experiences that spark curiosity and foster an interest in science.

We believe that great ideas are built by sharing knowledge, experimenting, and facing new challenges. We are passionate and committed people, and in addition to having skills in space sciences, programming, 3D modeling, animation, design, and web development, we are looking above all for a challenge to test ourselves—and that is why we created NOVA EON.
summary:
NOVA EON is an educational and interactive web platform designed to bring space exploration closer to children and young people through three-dimensional experiences. The project allows users to discover technologies used in NASA space missions, exploring their features, functions, and scientific importance.

Through interactive 3D environments, users can learn about different space exploration vehicles and technologies, such as lunar modules, rovers, and devices used on Mars. Each experience includes educational information and visual elements that make scientific concepts easier to understand.

NOVA EON addresses the challenge of making scientific learning more accessible, dynamic, and engaging. Its importance lies in transforming the way people learn about space, inspiring curiosity, encouraging interest in science, and bringing technology closer to new generations.
details:
NOVA EON is an interactive space exploration web platform that combines education, technology, and entertainment. It works through a first-person exploration experience, allowing users to select different missions, discover their objectives, and explore three-dimensional environments inspired by NASA's space exploration.

The project includes four main experiences: Apollo 11, Lunar Rover, Sojourner Rover, and Ingenuity Helicopter. Each one features a unique environment, educational information, objectives, and interactive elements that help users understand how these technologies work and their importance in space research.

Its main benefits include interactive learning, access to scientific information, and the development of curiosity about astronomy and technology. Its expected impact is to inspire children and young people to become more interested in science and make space exploration easier to understand.

The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with the Three.js library to create three-dimensional environments. Additional tools for web development and visual design were also used.

Its creativity lies in transforming historical and scientific information into digital exploration experiences. During development, the team considered ease of use, accessibility, scientific accuracy, visual quality, device compatibility, and the importance of making each mission a unique experience.
